resolutions.researcher_notes: Company-level ownership of 江西省天然气管道有限公司 (the operator/QCCOwner named for both P5865 and P5866) corroborated by TWO independent credit-rating documents on two distinct hosts: (1) CCXI's 2022 credit rating report on 江西省天然气集团有限公司 (hosted via Qixin/企查查's PDF cache, http://qxb-pdf-osscache.qixin.com/AnBaseinfo/85599868a5a6e3c2fc8db704da8180b8.pdf) — page text (line ~262) lists 江西省天然气管道有限公司/天然气管道公司 at '持股比例 54.00%'; (2) SSE's 2025-04-03 bond credit-rating report on 江西省投资集团有限公司 (https://static.sse.com.cn/disclosure/bond/announcement/company/c/new/2025-04-03/242696_20250403_SXBW.pdf) — footnote 5 states verbatim '天然气集团持有天然气管道公司54%的股权，剩余46%股权由国家管网集团东部原油储运有限公司（原"中国石化管道储运有限公司"）持有.'
